docs_coding_standards_body: Buri bitaro bihuza gahunda imwe yo gusuzuma indwara ya OMS (ICD-10 cyangwa ICD-11 MMS) mugihe cyo gukora. EMR ishakisha isuzuma ikoresha urwo rutonde gusa. Cataloge yuzuye itumizwa muri OMS ICD-API mumeza asangiwe.

admin_ops_db_note_live_counts: Imirongo yumubare ibarwa ni COUNT (*) kumeza yibanze, ntabwo igereranyo cya pg_stat.
admin_ops_db_note_connection_failed: Iperereza ryihuza ryatsinzwe. Reba DATABASE_URL na Neon ishami ryimiterere.

item_master_batch_required_help: Iyo bishobotse, ibicuruzwa byakiriwe bigomba kuba birimo nimero yicyiciro, itariki izarangiriraho, nigiciro cyubuguzi kuri iki kintu (gisanzwe kuri farumasi).
item_master_unit_conversions_default_toa: Hitamo ikintu cyambere, hanyuma ukoreshe Default kugirango uhuze impinduka zirimo.
Ntabwo guhindura ibice bikoresha iki gice kubigura cyangwa ikibazo.
item_master_unit_conversions_search_plac: Akayunguruzo ukoresheje inyandiko ihindura cyangwa id…
item_master_category_hint: Gusa Isoko Rusange, Isoko rya Farumasi, cyangwa Ubuvuzi (kuva mucyiciro cya Master).
item_master_pharmacy_generic_required: Hitamo farumasi rusange kubintu byo gutanga farumasi.
no_pharmacy_generics_create: Nta farumasi rusange. Kora imwe hejuru.
unit_master_empty: Nta gice na kimwe. Kora imwe hejuru.
confirm_delete_refer: Uzi neza ko ushaka gusiba iyi nyandiko?
support_select_ticket: Hitamo itike yo kureba amakuru arambuye.
nursing_case_sheet_choose_visit: Hitamo gusurwa ukoresheje buto 'Hitamo Gusura' hejuru kugirango urebe urupapuro rwimanza.
observation_emr_choose_visit: Hitamo uruzinduko ukoresheje buto 'Hitamo Gusura' hejuru kugirango urebe amakuru yo kureba.
clinical_visit_signed_banner: Uru ruzinduko rwakijijwe nkuko rwashyizweho umukono. Kwitegereza no guhindura CPOE birahagarikwa kugeza uhisemo urundi ruzinduko.
clinical_visit_unsign_confirm: Uzi neza gusiba kuzigama nkuko byashyizweho umukono?
observation_save_as_signed_confirm: Uzigame uru ruzinduko nkuko rwashyizweho umukono? Ibi ntibishobora gusubirwaho. Kwitegereza no guhindura CPOE bizahagarikwa kururu ruzinduko; umuforomo wakazi akomeza kuboneka.
observation_emr_casesheet_stub: Gahunda yo Kwitaho ntabwo iboneka muriyi nyubako. Koresha gahunda yubuforomo EMR yo kwitaho igihe yiteguye.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_empty: Nta gahunda yo kwita kuri uru ruzinduko.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_not_found: Iyo gahunda yo kwita kubitabo ntiyabonetse.
observation_emr_progress_note_stub: Inyandiko ziterambere ntiziboneka muriyi nyubako. Koresha ubuforomo bwa EMR butera imbere iyo bwiteguye.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_note_plac: Andika amabwiriza yandikiwe, imiti, dosiye, ninama kumurwayi…
observation_emr_order_line_locked_op_bil: Uyu murongo uri kuri fagitire ya OP ifunze kandi ntishobora guhindurwa cyangwa kudakora.
observation_emr_order_line_inactivate_hi: Uyu murongo wo gutondekanya uzarangwa no kudakora kandi usibye kwishyurwa rya OP.
observation_emr_form_entry_inactivate_hi: Ongera wandike ibisobanuro byanditse hepfo kugirango udakora iyi nyandiko.
delete_owner_confirm_suffix: ? Ibi bizakuraho konti yabo kandi ntibazongera kwinjira.
prefix_configuration_format_help: Ibice byahujwe murwego rwo kubaka buri kode. Ongeraho inyandiko ihamye, imirima yamakuru, numero ikora.
prefix_configuration_format_empty: Ongeraho byibuze igice kimwe kumiterere ya code.
prefix_configuration_format_load_failed: Imiterere yabitswe ntishobora gupakirwa; guhera ku miterere isanzwe.
prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Shiraho uburyo kode yabarwayi, gusura nimero, nimero ya serivise yubatswe. Buri ntego ikoresha urufunguzo rwa sisitemu ihamye; uhindura gusa ibisobanuro n'imiterere.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Ikoreshwa mugihe cyo kwandikisha abarwayi bashya. Ubwoko bwo gusura ntabwo buboneka kuriyi code.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Byakoreshejwe kuri buri gusura abarwayi; ikubiyemo ishami no gusura ubwoko iyo iyo mirima iri mumiterere.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Byakoreshejwe mugihe cyo gukora ibicuruzwa. Imiterere isanzwe ihuye na YY / gusura / NNN. Kanda kuri "Gutandukanya urutonde kuri buri gusura" kugirango utondekanye nimero zibara 001, 002… kuri buri murwayi (bisabwe). Niba bizimye, urukurikirane rusangiwe kubisabwa byose bikoresha izindi ntera igenamiterere.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Byakoreshejwe mugihe cyo gukora ibisabwa (PR). Hindura ibi mbere yuko abakozi bashobora gukora PR.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Byakoreshejwe mugihe cyo gukora ibicuruzwa (PO). Hindura ibi mbere yuko abakozi bashobora gukora POs.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Byakoreshejwe mugihe cyo gukora ibice byishami. Hindura ibi mbere yuko abakozi bashobora gukora indent.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Byakoreshejwe mugihe cyo gukora ibibazo byishami kuva hagati kugeza gusaba amaduka.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Ikoreshwa mugihe utanze ibyangombwa byo gukoresha ishami kugirango byemeze.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Ikoreshwa mugihe uzigama imiti yimbere. Imirongo yose muri imwe yo kuzigama igabana iyi nimero. Mburabuzi ikoresha umwaka wimari, ibitaro, nuburyo bukurikirana.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_help: Hitamo ibipimo bigabanya umubare ukoresha. Imiterere yo kwerekana hejuru iratandukanye; ibi bigira ingaruka gusa kumubare wigenga ubona.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_visit: Gutandukanya urutonde kuri buri bwoko bwo gusura
inv_grn_api_hint: Kora GRNs ukoresheje POST hamwe na poId, ububikoId (hagati), wakiriye Itariki, n'imirongo. Buri murongo: poLineId, yaguzweQty (usibye kubuntu), batchNo, igihe cyagenwe, kuguraIbiciro (bisabwa mugihe ikintu gifite icyiciro gikurikirana). Amatsinda arasanzwe (ikintu_icyiciro); ububiko buri kububiko no mubice (inv_stock).
inv_approval_config_intro: Kugena urwego rwo kwemeza hamwe nabashinzwe kububiko nubwoko bwinyandiko wahisemo hejuru.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Ibisubizo by'ishakisha birimo kuboko kububiko bwatoranijwe (kuva) ububiko gusa (ikibazo cyo gutanga iyo kiboneka).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: Reba ifungura iyi nyemezabuguzi kurupapuro rwayo; Garuka hano (ntabwo ari ikibazo cyishami).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Imirongo ni `inv_stock` ihujwe na` item_batch`, itegekwa kurangira (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Shungura amatsinda y'abakoresha izina cyangwa id…
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Injiza ingano yemewe kumurongo niba igomba gutandukana nibisabwa. Gutegereza PR qty igereranya imirongo iva muri iri duka risaba (ritegereje, ryoherejwe inyuma, cyangwa ryemewe), harimo nibisabwa.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Nta kintu na kimwe. Kanda + kugirango wongere ikintu, hanyuma ubike gahunda.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Hitamo ibyasabwe kugura hejuru. Imbonerahamwe izapakira hano hamwe na buri murongo: ikintu, igice (Ikintu cyibanze Master ihinduka), umubare usigaye, ingano yumubare, nigiciro cyibice.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Hitamo ikintu mbere, hanyuma uhitemo igice (guhinduka) uhereye kubintu byikintu Urutonde rwibanze.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Iki kintu ntigikorwa gihinduka. Mubashire munsi yububiko bwa → Ikintu gikuru.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Hitamo ububiko bwo kugura hagati murwego rwo hejuru. Ibisabwa byemewe kubicuruzwa bishya byashyizwe ku rutonde gusa iyo iryo duka ryatoranijwe - byoherejwe kugura hagati, ntabwo byoherejwe mu yandi maduka nka farumasi itari CPS yagenwe.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Shiraho ububiko rusange bwo kugura munsi yububiko bwa → Ibarura ryibitaro mbere yo gukora ibicuruzwa bivuye mubisabwa.
inv_po_close_line_confirm: Funga uyu murongo hanyuma ushireho ikimenyetso gisigaye qty nkuko gifunze?
inv_pr_close_line_confirm: Funga uyu murongo wa PR usigaye qty (shiraho gufungura-PO kuri 0)?
inv_grn_receiving_store_none_central: Nta bubiko bukuru bwashyizweho kuri iri shami ryubuguzi. Inyemezabwishyu y'ibicuruzwa igomba kumanikwa mububiko bukuru bwishami. Muburyo bwo kubara, shyira akamenyetso kububiko bumwe kuri buri shami nkibanze (ni ububiko hagati), hanyuma ugerageze.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Hitamo itegeko ryo kugura kugirango ubone ububiko bwakirwa.
inv_grn_batch_fields_hint: Umubare wumubare, igihe kirangirire, nigiciro cyo kugura birakenewe kubintu byakurikiranwe.
inv_transfer_pick_batch_hint: Hitamo byinshi mububiko bwinkomoko, cyangwa utware byinshi nyuma yo guhitamo ububiko.
inv_hub_card_po: Kurema no kwemeza ibicuruzwa byaguzwe, ohereza kubitanga.
inv_hub_card_grn: Andika inyemezabuguzi y'ibicuruzwa bivuye ku bicuruzwa byaguzwe.
inv_pr_approve_need_prId: Fungura iyi page hamwe na? PrId =… muri URL.
inv_po_approve_need_poId: Fungura iyi page hamwe na? PoId =… muri URL.
inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: PR, PO, na GRN kubicuruzwa byaguzwe koresha iri duka. Ububiko bwatoranijwe bwaranzwe no kugura hagati; iyambere isubira mubisanzwe.
inv_pr_trace_hint: Iyo umurongo wuzuye kurutonde rwubuguzi, ingano ifunguye ni 0 hano; inzira yatumijwe, yakiriwe, kandi iracyakomeza-kwakira kuri ecran ya PO na GRN.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Kugura ibicuruzwa birahari kuriyi PR ariko urutonde ntirushobora kuremererwa. Gerageza kugarura page.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Umurongo wo hejuru ushyiraho ububiko bwawe / busaba (kuva) ububiko. Urutonde rwerekana ibisabwa byazamuwe nububiko. Hitamo ububiko bwose kugirango ubone ibisabwa muri buri bubiko busaba, cyangwa ukoreshe ububiko bwinkingi muyunguruzi kugirango ugabanye Kububiko.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Ububiko bugarukira kububiko murwego rwo hejuru. Hitamo ububiko bwose kugirango ubone ububiko bwose mubitaro.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Urutonde rugarukira kumurongo uzamurwa nububiko murwego rwo hejuru. Hitamo ububiko bwose kugirango ubone ibice byose.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Kora ibyasabwe mububiko busaba (umurongo wo hejuru) → nyuma yo kwemezwa, kora itegeko ryo kugura hanyuma ushyire GRN mububiko bwakiriwe → kurutonde rwa GRN, koresha Transfer kugirango wimure ububiko bwakiriwe mububiko bwafunguye ibisabwa (mugihe PR ihujwe na PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Kuva mububiko biva kumurongo wo hejuru. Hitamo A Kubika iki gisabwa.
inv_flow_po_context: POs kububiko bwatoranijwe (umurongo wo hejuru) ukurikire ibyasabwe byemewe cyangwa ibyandikishijwe intoki; kwemeza noneho wohereze kubitanga mbere yo kwakira ibicuruzwa.
inv_flow_grn_context: Kohereza inyemezabuguzi mububiko bwakiriwe (umurongo wo hejuru). Iyo PO ihujwe no gusaba, koresha Transfer kugirango wohereze ububiko kububiko busaba nyuma yo kohereza GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Hitamo iduka mumurongo wo hejuru kugirango ushireho urutonde, cyangwa ukoreshe ibicuruzwa byose byaguzwe mubitaro mugihe nta bubiko bwatoranijwe.
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Ububiko bwo hagati (top bar = Kuva mububiko) butera ibibazo kububiko busaba: haba mubisata byemewe byemewe gutegereza gutegereza, cyangwa intoki nta indent.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Kimwe no kugura ibicuruzwa: koresha Gishya kuva murwego rwoherejwe mugihe ububiko busabwa mububiko bwawe bukuru ukoresheje indent; koresha Igitabo mugihe nta indent.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Hindura igenzura rya "Kuva mububiko" murwego rwo hejuru (kuruhande rwishami / itsinda ryabakoresha) mugihe igice cyibarura gifunguye.
inv_dept_issue_pending_indents_help: Ibi bimenyetso byemejwe nububiko busaba kandi bategereje ko ufungura ikibazo cyishami. Hitamo ububiko bwo hagati murwego rwo hejuru.
inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Kora ikibazo cyishami uhereye kubarura issue Ikibazo cyishami → Gishya kuva muri indent ishami (ububiko bwo hagati bugomba guhuza nububiko bwa "to" mububiko bwo hejuru).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Hitamo ububiko hagati (buzuza) mububiko bwo hejuru. Urutonde rwerekana ibibazo aho iryo duka ariryo ritanga (Kuva).
inv_page_receipt_from_store_subtitle: Emera inyemezabwishyu kububiko bwawe busaba (kuva mukabari). Ibimenyetso byatanzwe bigaragara hano kugeza byakiriwe.
inv_di_cancel_reason_prompt: Injira impamvu yo guhagarika iyi indent.
inv_receipt_from_store_select_store_hint: Hitamo ububiko bwawe busaba mumurongo wo hejuru kugirango urutonde urutonde rutegereje kwakirwa muri iryo duka.
inv_page_department_consumption_subtitle: Andika imikoreshereze mu iduka hamwe nogukata urwego. Tanga ibyemezo; kwemeza byanyuma inyandiko zikoreshwa kandi zigabanya ububiko.
inv_dc_list_scope_hint: Urutonde rushobora gukurikira ububiko murwego rwo hejuru cyangwa kwerekana ububiko bwose.
inv_dc_configure_dc_approvers: Kugena ibiciro byo gukoresha ishami (module DC) kuriyi mangazini muri Inventory Setup ibone Iboneza.
inv_dc_batch_table_empty: Nta cyiciro gifite ububiko kuriyi mangazini.
inv_dc_batch_qty_exceeds_stock: Umubare urenze ububiko buboneka kuri kimwe cyangwa byinshi.
medication_order_external_sales_empty: Igare ririmo ubusa. Ongeraho ibintu ibumoso.
med_order_save_failed: Ntushobora kuzigama. Reba ibyo winjije hanyuma ugerageze.
med_order_delete_confirm: Siba uyu murongo? Ibi ntibishobora gusubirwaho.
med_order_batch_pick_help: Injiza ingano kuri buri cyiciro (igice cyo kugura). Igiteranyo gihuza umurongo ingano yumurima.

home_seo_title: Menzies Medora | Tuza ibikorwa byibitaro kuri buri tsinda ryita ku barwayi
home_seo_description: Medora ni ibitaro byinshi EMR kugirango yiyandikishe, asure, imirimo yubuvuzi, ibarura, nubuyobozi. Imashini imwe yoroshye yo gukaraba kuri ba nyirayo, abakozi, hamwe na etage.
home_hero_headline: Hindura iminsi yibitaro mumazi atuje, ahujwe
home_hero_body: Medora: ibikorwa byo kwita kubitaro byinshi hamwe no kwiyandikisha, gusura, intebe zubuvuzi, no kubara muri konsole imwe ikodeshwa.
home_how_lead: Inzira imwe yo gutembera no kwita kubitabo. Yubatswe kumwanya amakipe yimura abarwayi.
home_how_step1_body: Gufata indangamuntu, allergie, n'amateka rimwe. Buri gusura nyuma byongeye gukoresha imbonerahamwe imwe.
home_how_step2_body: Kora OP cyangwa IP gusura, komatanya gahunda, kandi ugumane imiterere yishami hasi.
home_how_step3_body: Ubuforomo, kwisuzumisha, gutumiza imiti, hamwe nibyangombwa bibaho mugihe kimwe cyo gusura.
home_how_step4_body: Ibibazo by'ibarura, fagitire zo kwishyuza, hamwe n'intambwe zo gusohora biguma bihujwe na dosiye yo gusura.
home_modules_lead: Ubushobozi paki zitwikiriye ameza agomba kuguma muri sync: ibiro byimbere, amagorofa, amaduka, na admin.
home_modules_registration_body: Umuyobozi wihangane, sura ibyaremwe, gahunda, hamwe nishami-rizi.
home_modules_clinical_body: Ubuforomo no kugisha inama module hamwe na vitals, gusuzuma, gutumiza, hamwe na EMR inoti.
home_modules_inventory_body: Amaduka, ibyiciro, PR / PO / GRN, imikoreshereze yishami, hamwe no kumenyesha ibicuruzwa.
home_modules_admin_body: Abakozi, amashami, amatsinda y'abakoresha, shobuja, inyandiko, hamwe n'ibitaro.
home_model_heading: SaaS imwe. Ibitaro byinshi. Inshingano zisobanutse.
home_model_lead: Medora ni ibitaro byinshi kubishushanyo mbonera. Ihuriro rikora ibitaro. Ibitaro bikora ubuvuzi. Abarwayi ntibigera bakeneye ibiro byinyuma.
home_model_platform_body: Sisitemu iyobora abafite imbuto, ibitaro, hamwe nuburinzi buri mugabane ukodesha.
home_model_hospital_body: Ba nyirubwite n'abayobozi bashiraho amashami, ububiko, abakozi kubona, na shobuja.
home_model_staff_body: Abaforomo, abaganga, hamwe nitsinda ryububiko bakora kuva module izi neza uruhare hasi.
home_model_patients_body: Imbonerahamwe, gusurwa, n'inyandiko bigumana n'ibitaro; abakozi bakorera kuri konsole.
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Ibyingenzi, allergie, inyandiko zabaforomo, nimirimo yo kuryama utiriwe usura.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Gusuzuma, gutegeka imiti, hamwe nubuvuzi bwamavuriro kumeza ya muganga.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Kwakira, gutanga, kwimura, no kugenzura ububiko hamwe nicyiciro kirangiye.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Abakozi, amashami, amatsinda yinjira, abashinzwe inyandiko, hamwe niboneza.
home_integrated_lead: Ishyirwaho, imiti, inyandiko, hamwe nububiko bwimigabane bisangira uruzinduko kugirango ijambo rigume hamwe.
home_cta_body: Injira muri kanseri ya Medora, hitamo ibitaro, hanyuma utangire kuri module ikipe yawe isanzwe ikoresha.
home_footer_tagline: Ibikorwa byibitaro byo kwiyandikisha, kuvura kwa muganga, kubara, no kuyobora.

pricing_seo_title: Menzies Medora igiciro | Igicu na On-premise
pricing_seo_description: Ibitaro bya Medora EMR igiciro: Igicu kuva $ 99 / mo (Gutangira kugera kuri platform). Kubanza gukoresha ibyiciro bimwe kubiciro bya Cloud + $ 150 / mo kugirango ushyire mubikorwa remezo byawe. Kwiyandikisha, ivuriro, kubara, na admin.
pricing_lead: Igicu SaaS cyangwa Kuri-remezo kubikorwa remezo byawe. Intangiriro imwe, Ubucuruzi, Umunzani, hamwe na platform. Ingano y'ibitaro na modul, ntabwo kuri buri gusura metero ihangayitse.
pricing_lead_cloud: Igicu cyakiriwe na Soft Wash Medora: ibitaro byinshi SaaS, bigezweho, hamwe nibikorwa remezo bisangiwe kurubuga ukoresha.
pricing_lead_onprem: Kuri-progaramu ni kimwe murwego rwibicuruzwa, byashyizweho kandi bigashyirwa kuri seriveri yawe, ububikoshingiro, hamwe numuyoboro. Ufite ibikorwa remezo. Urutonde rwa buri kwezi ni Cloud + $ {premium} kuri iyo nshingano.

pricing_who_heading: Ikarita yerekana uburyo bwo kwita kuri Medora
pricing_who_lead: Ihuriro, ibitaro, abakozi, n'abarwayi buri wese abona inzira isobanutse. Tora Igicu cyangwa On-premise, hanyuma urwego rumwe ruhuye nibitaro hamwe na module ukoresha.
pricing_who_platform_body: Abakozi babiba ibitaro byinshi kandi bakeneye ibirango byera wongeyeho SSO. Hitamo Platform kuri Cloud cyangwa On-premise.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Ba nyirubwite n'abayobozi bashiraho amashami, ububiko, uburyo bwabakozi, na shobuja. Ubucuruzi cyangwa Igipimo gihuza amatsinda menshi yimbuga.
pricing_who_staff_body: Abaforomo, abaganga, hamwe nububiko bwamakipe kuri module-izi uruhare. Intebe igabanya igipimo hamwe na gahunda; abarwayi ntibigera babona ibiro byinyuma.
pricing_who_patients_body: Imbonerahamwe, gusurwa, hamwe ninyandiko bigumana nibitaro. Abakozi bakorera kuri konsole murwego rwo kwiyandikisha binyuze hafi.
pricing_faq_q1: Ibiciro kuri buri gusura cyangwa ku cyicaro cyabakozi?
pricing_faq_a1: Ibyiciro byatangajwe kuri buri tsinda ryibitaro bifite ibitaro hamwe nintebe. Igicu na On-premise gusangira Intangiriro, Ubucuruzi, Igipimo, na platform. Urutonde rwa buri kwezi ni Cloud + $ 150. Nta buryo na bumwe bukoresha metero imwe yo gusura izamuka muminsi myinshi.
pricing_faq_a2: Buri mwaka fagitire ifunga mumwaka uteganijwe wa Soft Wash Medora. Ibitaro byuburyo bwa SaaS akenshi bigabanya gahunda yumwaka hafi 15 kugeza 20%. Medora ikoresha 20% kurutonde rwa buri kwezi iyo wishyuye buri mwaka, kuri Cloud na On-premise (nyuma ya $ 150 $ On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_a3: Intangiriro ikubiyemo kwiyandikisha kwingenzi, gusurwa, hamwe nintebe yakazi yubuvuzi hamwe nububiko bwibanze. Ubucuruzi no hejuru gufungura ibikorwa byuzuye byuzuye, amabwiriza yimiti ihujwe nububiko, hamwe nubuyobozi bukize bwa admin. Baza igihe ukeneye inyongera zagenwe.
pricing_faq_a4: Koresha isoko uhindagurika hejuru ya gahunda. Isi yose yerekana USD gusa. Miyanimari yerekana MMK kuri 1 USD = 5000 MMK (hamwe na USD nk'umurongo wa kabiri). Igihe cyo kwishyuza nuburyo bwa serivisi butandukanye nisoko.
pricing_faq_a5: Igicu cyakiriwe na Soft Wash Medora: ibitaro byinshi SaaS, gucunga neza, no gutangira byihuse. Kubanza gukoresha ibyiciro bimwe, byashyizwe mubikorwa remezo mugihe ukeneye kugenzura cyangwa gutura. Infra ni iyanyu; urutonde rwa buri kwezi ni Cloud + $ 150 kubwizo nshingano.
